title: The Community Library's New Opening Hours
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答16个问题。所有题目均基于短文内容，答案必须来自原文。题目类型包括单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。判断题请根据原文选择True（正确）、False（错误）或Not Given（未提及）。本材料为模拟练习，并非官方雅思试题。
passage:
A
Last month, the Westside Community Library changed its opening hours. The library is now open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays, and from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays. The library manager, Mrs. Chen, said the new hours help more people visit after work. Before the change, the library closed at 5 p.m., so many workers could not come.

B
The library also started a new service called "Homework Help." On Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m., volunteers help students with their homework. The volunteers are high school students and retired teachers. Mrs. Chen said, "We have ten volunteers now, but we need more." Students do not need to pay for this service. They only need to bring their student cards.

C
Another change is the book return box. It is now outside the library, next to the front door. People can return books even when the library is closed. The box is open 24 hours a day. However, DVDs and magazines cannot go in the box. People must return those inside the library.

D
Mrs. Chen also said the library will have a book sale next month. The sale will be on Saturday, June 15, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. in the library meeting room. Most books will cost one dollar, and some special books will cost five dollars. All money from the sale will buy new books for children. Mrs. Chen hopes many people will come.

questions.prompt: What time does the library close on weekdays now?
questions.explanation: 原文第一段明确说“The library is now open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays”，所以工作日晚上8点关门。
questions.evidence: The library is now open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays

questions.prompt: On which day is the library closed?
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“It is closed on Sundays”，所以星期日不开放。

questions.prompt: Who helps students with homework?
options: High school students and retired teachers
answers: High school students and retired teachers
questions.explanation: 原文第二段提到“The volunteers are high school students and retired teachers”，所以帮助作业的是高中生和退休教师。
questions.evidence: The volunteers are high school students and retired teachers.

questions.prompt: What do students need to bring to get homework help?
questions.explanation: 原文第二段最后一句说“They only need to bring their student cards”，所以学生只需带学生证。
questions.evidence: They only need to bring their student cards.

questions.prompt: Where is the book return box now?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“It is now outside the library, next to the front door”，所以还书箱在前门旁边。
questions.evidence: It is now outside the library, next to the front door.

questions.prompt: What cannot be returned in the outside box?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“However, DVDs and magazines cannot go in the box”，所以DVD和杂志不能放进外面的还书箱。
questions.evidence: However, DVDs and magazines cannot go in the box.

questions.prompt: When is the book sale?
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“The sale will be on Saturday, June 15, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.”，所以图书特卖在6月15日星期六。
questions.evidence: The sale will be on Saturday, June 15, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

questions.prompt: How much will most books cost at the sale?
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“Most books will cost one dollar”，所以大多数书一美元。
questions.evidence: Most books will cost one dollar

questions.prompt: The library is open until ______ p.m. on Saturdays. (Fill in the blank with one word or number from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturdays”，所以星期六开放到下午4点。
questions.evidence: from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturdays

questions.prompt: The Homework Help service is on Tuesdays and ______. (Fill in the blank with one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“On Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.”，所以作业帮助在星期二和星期四。
questions.evidence: On Tuesdays and Thursdays, from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m.

questions.prompt: The book return box is open ______ hours a day. (Fill in the blank with one word or number from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“The box is open 24 hours a day”，所以还书箱一天24小时开放。
questions.evidence: The box is open 24 hours a day.

questions.prompt: All money from the book sale will buy new books for ______. (Fill in the blank with one word from the passage.)
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“All money from the sale will buy new books for children”，所以卖书的钱给孩子们买新书。
questions.evidence: All money from the sale will buy new books for children.

questions.prompt: True or False: The library is open on Sundays now.
questions.explanation: 原文第一段明确说“It is closed on Sundays”，所以图书馆星期日不开放，题目说开放是错误的。

questions.prompt: True or False: The Homework Help service is free for students.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“Students do not need to pay for this service”，所以作业帮助服务对学生免费，题目正确。
questions.evidence: Students do not need to pay for this service.

questions.prompt: True or False: The library has more than ten volunteers now.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“We have ten volunteers now, but we need more”，说明现在有十名志愿者，不是超过十名，所以题目错误。
questions.evidence: We have ten volunteers now, but we need more.

questions.prompt: True or False: The book sale will be in the library meeting room.
questions.explanation: 原文第四段说“in the library meeting room”，所以图书特卖在图书馆会议室举行，题目正确。

grammar.title: 基础时态、问句、名词数量和常见从句综合复习
grammar.explanation: 本部分复习一般现在时（表示事实和习惯）、一般过去时（表示过去发生的事）、一般将来时（表示计划或预测）、特殊疑问句（What/When/Where/Who/How much等）、名词单复数（如book→books, volunteer→volunteers）以及常见从句（如宾语从句、时间状语从句）。请根据句子意思选择正确的形式。
grammar.example: The library is now open from 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. on weekdays.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence.
options: She go to the library every day.
She goes to the library every day.
She going to the library every day.
She gone to the library every day.
answers: She goes to the library every day.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语是第三人称单数she时，动词go要加-es，变为goes。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句结构为“疑问词+助动词+主语+动词原形”，主语the library是第三人称单数，助动词用does，动词用原形open。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct plural form: one book, two ______.
questions.explanation: 名词book的复数形式是直接加-s，变为books。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with a clause.
options: I think that the library is closed on Sundays.
I think that the library closed on Sundays.
I think the library is closed on Sundays?
I think what the library is closed on Sundays.
answers: I think that the library is closed on Sundays.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句用that引导，从句用陈述语序，且表示一般事实用一般现在时is closed。
